import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartVMonotone
import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.LocallyBijective

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u
open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace ProbeP4R6

theorem controlSorry : True := by sorry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]

theorem probeSheaf (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf Scheme.zariskiTopology (yoneda.obj X) :=
  (isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type _ _).mpr
    (GrothendieckTopology.Subcanonical.isSheaf_of_isRepresentable (yoneda.obj X))

noncomputable def chartSheaf (X : Scheme.{u}) : Sheaf Scheme.zariskiTopology.{u} (Type u) :=
  ⟨yoneda.obj X, probeSheaf X⟩

noncomputable def chartSheafHom {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) :
    chartSheaf X ⟶ pic0SigmaSheaf C :=
  Sheaf.Hom.mk f

theorem probeLocInj {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
    (hf : IsOpenImmersion.presheaf f) :
    Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective Scheme.zariskiTopology f :=
  Presheaf.isLocallyInjective_of_injective _ _
    (fun T => injective_of_isOpenImmersion_presheaf hf T)

/-- THE COLLAPSE. -/
theorem probeIso {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
    (hf : IsOpenImmersion.presheaf f)
    (hsurj : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology f) :
    IsIso (chartSheafHom (C := C) f) := by
  haveI : Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (chartSheafHom (C := C) f).hom :=
    probeLocInj f hf
  haveI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (chartSheafHom (C := C) f).hom :=
    hsurj
  exact (Sheaf.isLocallyBijective_iff_isIso (chartSheafHom (C := C) f)).mp
    ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

end ProbeP4R6

end AlgebraicGeometry
